name: cmdgate
description: A second opinion under Claude Code's permission prompt for shell commands: safe/unsafe, risk level, dangerous and root access, from your locally running Command Gate app.

endpoint.title: Backend endpoint
endpoint.description: Decision API endpoint of the locally running Command Gate app.

model.title: Model
model.description: Value sent as `model` in each request, to pick one of the app's models.

timeoutMs.title: Timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the app before showing 'no answer'.

threshold.title: Yes threshold
threshold.description: Probability at or above which a yes/no answer reads as yes.

forwardToIde.title: Forward to IDE add-ons
forwardToIde.description: Also send each result to IDE add-ons listening on this machine (e.g. the Command Gate VS Code add-on).
